author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
#stopthesteal

 Spirits
of our nation's
   nightmare
descended on to
  our Temple of Jupiter
As we stumbled down
  the seven hills of
history to a better tomorrow
  The ignorant fear
progress
  their blood
spilled on sandstone stacked
  by slaves
A Rotunda of shame
  undeserving of America's
Name.
Let us pillage hate
that invades our National
   soul
into Spoila of a better
  tomorrow
